work.englishTitle: MAXQ Special Edition + MAXQ Compilation Vol. 04: Park Eunhye
work.summary: Digital MAXQ compilation photobook featuring Park Eunhye, a Korean YouTube creator and model. RIDI identifies the exact 53-page PDF e-book, released 2024-08-28. Its product description says it combines online-unreleased MAXQ Special Edition pictorials with MAXQ best and unpublished cuts. This numbered compilation is a distinct retailer product; overlap with Park Eunhye's Secret B and other MAXQ images has not been checked. No ISBN is listed. Metadata only; no cover or paid e-book copied.

edition.contentSummary: RIDI lists <스페셜 에디션+맥스큐> 합본호 Vol.04: 박은혜 as a 53-page PDF e-book published 2024-08-28 by MAXQ International; file size 11.4 MB. The product description says it combines online-unreleased MAXQ Special Edition pictorials with MAXQ magazine best and unpublished cuts. Image overlap with Park Eunhye's other MAXQ and Secret B issues has not been checked. No ISBN is listed; no cover or paid file is copied.
